title: On Subscribing to the county paper for years
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：subscribe　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 subscribe 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the gardener ① subscribed to the county paper for years before dawn, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② subscribes to the county paper for years in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ subscribe to the county paper for years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ subscribed to the county paper for years before — a line in the notebook for April 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Subscribing to the county paper for years before dawn, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ subscribe a shilling a week to the school in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Subscribe a shilling a week to the school at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ subscribes a shilling a week to the school before dawn every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ subscribed to the county paper for years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To subscribe to the county paper for years, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody subscribes to the county paper for years in public again and somebody must subscribe to the county paper for years before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 订阅（一般过去式 subscribed to the county paper for years：1988 年园丁头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 订阅（一般现在 subscribes to the county paper for years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 订阅（不定式 to subscribe to the county paper for years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 订阅（过去完成时 had subscribed to the county paper for years：1982 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 订阅（动名词 subscribing to the county paper for years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 捐款（subscribe a shilling a week to the school：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去捐款每周给学堂捐一先令）
G. v. 捐款（subscribe a shilling a week to the school：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 订阅（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 subscribes a shilling a week to the school，而母亲又一次 subscribed to the county paper for years）

answers.why: subscribe 意为“订阅”，1988 年园丁天没亮就订阅多年订阅那份县报，那是园子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 subscribed。
subscribe 意为“订阅”，自那以后园丁当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 subscribes。
subscribe 意为“订阅”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯订阅多年订阅那份县报”，此处为不定式 to subscribe to the county paper for years。
subscribe 意为“订阅”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1995 年之前就有人订阅过，故用过去完成时 had subscribed。
subscribe 意为“订阅”，园丁说“订阅多年订阅那份县报这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 subscribing to the county paper for years 作主语。
subscribe 意为“捐款”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去捐款每周给学堂捐一先令”，should ever 之后用原形 subscribe a shilling a week to the school。
subscribe 意为“捐款”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻捐款每周给学堂捐一先令（subscribe a shilling a week to the school at once），以后再也不要提起。
subscribe 意为“订阅”，新来的学徒每个春天都照例捐款每周给学堂捐一先令，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 subscribes。
subscribe 意为“订阅”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就订阅多年订阅那份县报，用一般过去式 subscribed 叙述。
subscribe 意为“订阅”，结尾那句是母亲 2000 年的话：要订阅多年订阅那份县报，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和园子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 subscribe 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the gardener subscribed to the county paper for years before dawn, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener subscribes to the county paper for years in public whenever the garden asks.
Subscribing to the county paper for years before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever subscribe a shilling a week to the school in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden subscribes a shilling a week to the school before dawn every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother subscribed to the county paper for years again, and the garden remembered that half.
